einzeiler: Guests share wild, unexpected and sometimes accidental stories of ending up in jail.
kurzfassung: Guests call in to share their most memorable, chaotic, and unexpected experiences of getting arrested in their youth. The stories range from falling through a bank's skylight in Austin to accidentally launching fireworks at a police car. Along the way, the hosts react with empathy, humor, and disbelief.
stichpunkte: Jordan recounts a college night in Austin involving rooftop exploration and accidentally falling through a bank skylight.
Jordan manages to convince an officer he was a victim of punks before getting arrested later near the getaway car.
Chris describes a night out in New York City where a friend throws a bottle off a 14-story rooftop bar.
After running from authorities, Chris gets tackled, stripped of a favorite polo shirt, and thrown into a holding cell without a shirt.
Chris spends a freezing night in the Manhattan Criminal Court holding cells surrounded by hundreds of detainees.
Erica shares a 4th of July celebration in Colorado involving excessive drinking and a stray Roman candle hitting a police cruiser.
Erica faces serious charges that eventually get dropped after completing classes, allowing her to adopt her son years later.

clips.hook: A wayward glass projectile lands frighteningly close to security.
clips.text: An object thrown from a high-rise balcony nearly strikes a staff member on the street far below.

clips.hook: A holding facility quickly fills up with hundreds of new arrivals.
clips.text: The population inside a municipal detention area expands exponentially over a short period.

clips.hook: A stray pyrotechnic device bounces directly off a cruiser's window.
clips.text: A holiday celebration takes a severe turn when a projectile strikes an active patrol vehicle.
